# ScribeCat 0.24.4

This release adds inline PDF insertion without changing the existing PDF-to-note importer.

## PDF as an inline visual attachment

The editor's existing **Insert image** button now also accepts PDF files.

- A selected PDF is rendered page by page.
- Every page is saved as a PNG in the note's normal `_attachments` folder.
- The rendered pages are inserted directly into the Markdown note as images.
- The PDF is therefore visible inside the note instead of appearing as a link.

The same inline behaviour is available when a PDF is pasted from the clipboard or dropped directly into the editor.

## Existing PDF import is preserved

Dropping/importing a PDF through the file-list import flow still converts it into a separate Markdown note, including the existing text/image extraction behaviour. Other document formats continue to use that import-as-note flow too.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Reidar96/scribecat/compare/v0.24.3...v0.24.4
